description: Every Huntress endpoint, plus fleet-wide incident, coverage, and billing rollups the API can't.

novel_features.name: fleet-incidents
novel_features.description: One unified, age-sorted incident queue across every client organization, with org names joined in — the morning-sweep view the dashboard can't give.

novel_features.name: coverage-gaps
novel_features.description: Flags orgs and agents with stale callbacks, unhealthy Defender/firewall, or outdated EDR versions — a fleet posture exposure report.

novel_features.name: blast-radius
novel_features.description: Given an indicator (external IP, file hash, or foothold signature), finds every agent, org, and incident that matches it — instant correlation during incident response.

novel_features.name: triage-age
novel_features.description: SLA aging report: open incidents bucketed by hours-open, broken out by org and severity, with breaches flagged.

novel_features.name: billing-reconcile
novel_features.description: Compares invoiced and subscribed seat counts against actually deployed agent counts per org and surfaces the delta.

novel_features.name: drift
novel_features.description: Diffs the current sync against the prior snapshot: new and removed agents, status flips, new criticals, and version changes.

novel_features.name: mttr
novel_features.description: Computes mean time-to-resolve for incidents from sent-to-resolved timestamps, grouped by org or severity.

novel_features.name: canary-watch
novel_features.description: Surfaces only ransomware-canary and foothold incidents in a time window — the highest-signal early-ransomware indicators, fleet-wide.

novel_features.name: org-scorecard
novel_features.description: Per-client QBR scorecard: agent count, coverage percent, open and closed incidents, MTTR, and a posture grade — one client's security story.

novel_features.name: stale-agents
novel_features.description: Lists agents whose last callback exceeds a threshold — decommissioned-but-billed machines or broken installs.

novel_features.name: handoff
novel_features.description: Shift-change report of what changed (new criticals, resolutions, escalations) since a timestamp, ready to paste into a handoff note.

novel_features.name: incident-detail
novel_features.description: See one incident fully enriched — its remediations, the affected agent, and the org name — in a single lookup.

novel_features.name: fleet-summary
novel_features.description: One-screen fleet top-line: total orgs, agents, open criticals, oldest unactioned critical, orgs below coverage threshold, stale agents.

novel_features.name: reseller-rollup
novel_features.description: Per-account roll-up for resellers: invoice total, subscribed seats, and deployed agent count side by side.

novel_features.name: signal-digest
novel_features.description: Groups SOC signals by type and organization over a time window, with reported-versus-closed counts: what the Huntress SOC saw across the fleet.

novel_features.name: escalation-queue
novel_features.description: Unresolved escalations across the fleet, critical first and oldest first, with hours open and the organizations each one names: the environmental-issue backlog the incident queue does not show.
